sections.heading: Conscious Architecture Meets High Performance Building.

items.text: How They Pulled It Off: Moving a 1970s Craftsman to a New Location

sections.heading: Innovation.  Quality Craftsmanship.
sections.body: Cayoosh Construction Limited is a Whistler based family business specializing in custom homes and renovations. We value good communication and efficiency. Although there is considerable opportunity within the construction industry in the Sea to Sky corridor, we prioritize quality control and management continuity over exponential growth. In a quickly changing construction industry, we continue to focus on staying ahead of the curve on building code changes, new technologies, and new building techniques and processes.

sections.quote: “We did a very technical build with Seamus and his crew, which involved many unique building techniques and unusual materials. Seamus approached every detail methodically while always keeping us involved in every aspect of the decision making. We always felt a great sense of control & understanding which comes only from this level of involvement and partnership.”

sections.heading: Get in touch.
sections.body: Whether it's an energy upgrade or renovation on your current house, or building a custom home from start to finish, we look forward to working with you on your next project.

data.search_description: Cayoosh Construction Limited is a Whistler based family business specializing in custom homes and renovation, where conscious architecture meets high performance building technologies and processes.

data.title: Our Process

steps.title: Communication
steps.body: The management team members at Cayoosh Construction have many communication tools at our disposal to ensure that our clients are well informed and empowered to make decisions, big or small.  Regular email communication of details including cost and schedule specifics are critical to an efficient project, with follow up meetings taking place on site or virtually by Zoom or FaceTime.  We also work with design firms who have the capability to generate photo rendered 3D images that are accurate to the finest detail. In any case we are flexible, and can tailor our process to suit your needs.

steps.title: Attention to Detail
steps.body: Modern, highly designed architectural homes often bring many materials and systems together in one space. These systems and materials need to work seamlessly together to create the clean lines in spaces which often rely on minimalist design.  Although these spaces seem simple, the details behind the scenes can be complex.  At Cayoosh Construction we embrace the challenge and are well qualified to work with architects and designers at a high level.  Cayoosh Construction has an experienced team of employees and extensive field of sub-contractors and suppliers who are not only capable, but are excited to execute the details of highly designed architectural homes.

steps.title: Start to Finish
steps.body: Well versed in the challenges of developing a mountain property, we prefer to be involved in your construction process from the day you start looking at properties and options.  With no obligation to engage us, we are happy to be involved in the evaluation of any potential building site or renovation.  As you move into the planning and design phase of your project, we can help to identify the different aspects of your build and how they relate to your schedule and budget.

sections.heading: “We were pleased to recently represent the buyer on the sale of a magnificently built home by Cayoosh Construction.”
sections.attribution: - Dani O’Neil, Whistler Real Estate Company

data.search_description: Cayoosh Construction streamlines the building process with expert craftsmanship and transparency. From concept to completion, we deliver high-quality, on-time results for Whistler’s residential and commercial projects. Start building with us today.

data.title: High Performance Building

cards.title: Leading Edge Technologies
cards.body: Cayoosh Construction is well versed in modern building technology and energy efficient building. The management team at Cayoosh Construction takes pride in being at the cutting edge of a constantly evolving construction landscape. We live in an exciting, transformational time in the building industry where energy efficiency and sustainability are driving significant change.

cards.title: Integrative Approach
cards.body: This transformational time requires an integrative approach to building assemblies and Cayoosh Construction employs this approach in everything we do.  Whether building to the current provincial step code requirements or going above and beyond net zero construction, we have the experience and knowledge to optimize the assemblies for any building project.

cards.title: Exceeding Industry Standards
cards.body: In addition to many hours of continued professional development focused on new building techniques and technologies, we have also recently completed a British Columbia step code 4 duplex build with excellent performance results including a 0.64 ACH air tightness rating.

sections.quote: If you are looking for a High Performance Builder, Seamus and the team at Cayoosh is the right builder for you.  We’ve really enjoyed working with Cayoosh over the years, as they understand Building Science, attention to detail and are strong believers in the Integrated design process right from the start of the project.  Cayoosh truly are professionals, they build quality homes that are not only extremely energy efficient, but comfortable, healthy, and durable to live in.
sections.attribution: — Luke Dolan, Principal.  Capital Home Energy Inc.

sections.title: High Performance Renovations
sections.body: As British Columbia transitions to renewable energy and more efficient building techniques, we have the expertise, resources, and professional consultants available to renovate your home from its current state to a modern net zero home.

data.search_description: Cayoosh Construction leads in modern building technology and energy-efficient construction in Whistler. Our expert team stays at the forefront of innovation, delivering high-performance homes that reduce energy costs and environmental impact. Trust us for cutting-edge solutions in sustainable building.

data.title: Our Team

sections.heading: The Cayoosh Team
sections.body:
At Cayoosh Construction we have a team of experienced, motivated carpenters and apprentices and many on our team have worked with the company for years.  We are proud to offer a comprehensive benefits package to our employees and their families. In a town where staff turnover is common, we have maintained a stable workforce of great people, many of whom are putting down permanent roots in the community.

We value our employees and strive to create a work environment that is safe and encourages learning. We are a member of the I.T.A. apprenticeship program for employees who choose to pursue a red seal designation, and encourage and support employees who endeavour to further their training and expertise in home building.

sections.heading: Interested in joining us?
sections.body: We are always on the look out for new talent to join our team.  At Cayoosh Construction, we offer competitive wages, apprentice opportunities under a Red Seal carpenter, comprehensive benefits package and the 20 cm rule - whenever possible.

data.search_description: Cayoosh Construction is powered by a skilled and motivated team of experienced carpenters and apprentices in Whistler. Our dedicated professionals bring top-quality craftsmanship to every project, ensuring superior results for residential and commercial builds.
